text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A after large gains reduced my exposure, but gains versus my purchase price alone do not tell me whether to hold; I should weigh each stock’s outlook and the portfolio as a whole.","My account fell sharply over the last two periods, but short-term moves are not a reliable signal to trade. I should review my plan calmly rather than react to recent performance.","I bought several stocks in one period, and they soon lost value. Diversifying helps spread risk, but I should still assess each holding consistently and be willing to reconsider it—even when doing so means recognizing a loss."]}
